description.zh:
策略任务ID。
>调用[DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~DescribeSoarStrategyTasks~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the policy task.
>Call the [DescribeSoarStrategyTasks](~~DescribeSoarStrategyTasks~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
任务动作状态。取值：
- SCHEDULE：调度
- PAUSE：暂停
description.en:
The action status of the task. Valid values:
- SCHEDULE: scheduling
- PAUSE: pause.

title.zh: 执行任务中心的策略任务
title.en: Execute a policy task in the task center

descriptions.zh: 仅云安全中心的企业版和旗舰版支持该API调用，其他版本不支持。
descriptions.en: Only the Enterprise and Ultimate editions of Security Center support this API call. Other editions do not support this operation.
